title: Coding a Nuclear Orbital Strike Cannon with ONLY Command Blocks and Blowing up a Famous Youtuber!
description:
So I decided to make a Nuclear Orbital Strike cannon in addition to recreating the normal Orbital Strike Cannons using only command blocks in vanilla minecraft. Then I decide to use them on a well known youtuber in a pvp battle with maces. This is the one of the best creations I have made in minecraft so far!


World download is on my discord server!
https://discord.gg/h4J8z4Bm6W


Thanks to Guppyduck for the rotating armor stand idea for the big explosion! Thanks to Henry Cat for the original raycasting system! Thanks to swordfull and Den for the idea of making Orbital Strike cannons with commands in general!
